findings: Native LOWER/UPPER preserve invalid leading-byte chunks, including ASCII letters consumed within those chunks.
GLib lowercases capital sigma based only on the immediate next letter category, including singleton final sigma and marks that stop the lookahead; JavaScript uses different contextual casing.
GLib copies uncased LetterNumber/OtherSymbol case pairs such as Roman numerals and circled letters that JavaScript transforms.
Native uppercase Greek U0345 moves after following marks and drops combining dots from that consumed run; qualify before implementing.
